summary: This is an 8-K filed by Brookfield Asset Management Ltd. to announce its second quarter 2026 earnings conference call scheduled for August 5, 2026. No special-situation event—such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change—is disclosed. The filing simply provides routine details on the timing of the earnings release and how investors can access the call and webcast. As a routine current report regarding an ordinary earnings announcement, it does not qualify as a special situation.
